questions.q: I want to visit next Tuesday, December 1. Who is speaking and where do I go?
questions.theirs: The dated program lists Dr. Josh Walter on nuclear energy for December 1, 2026. Regular meetings are Tuesday, 7–8:30 a.m. Pacific at Cascades Grille, first floor of Embassy Suites Bellevue, 3225 158th Ave SE, Bellevue 98008. First-time guests are offered a free full breakfast; the PO Box is for mail.
questions.ours:
**Dr. Josh Walter** is scheduled to speak about nuclear energy on Tuesday, December 1, 2026.

The club’s published regular meeting is **7:00–8:30 a.m. Pacific** at Cascades Grille, first floor of Embassy Suites Bellevue, 3225 158th Ave SE, Bellevue, WA 98008. Schedules can change, so check the club website before visiting.

Guests are welcome, and first-time guests are offered a free full breakfast. [December 1 program details](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107234&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=2CEkfrLiLRKh&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bellevuesunriserotary.org%2Fjosh-walter-nuclear-energy%2F)

**Visitor:** Should I go to the PO Box, and is breakfast free for a first-time guest?

**Subsights:** No—the PO Box is the mailing address, not the meeting venue. For the December 1 meeting, go to **Cascades Grille**, first floor of Embassy Suites Bellevue, 3225 158th Ave SE, Bellevue, WA 98008.

Yes, first-time guests are offered a **free full breakfast**. [Meeting and contact details](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107236&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=2CEkfrLiLRKh&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bellevuesunriserotary.org%2Fcontact-us%2F)
questions.outcome: Keep the program date and meeting venue together; the postal address is for mail.

questions.q: I live in Redmond and my refrigerator broke. Am I guaranteed a replacement?
questions.theirs: The homepage mentions Redmond, Bellevue and Renton, while Projects describes Bellevue and Renton. The club and community partners screen candidates. questions.ours:

**Subsights:** I can’t send money or book an installation. The $610 is a historical average replacement cost, not a payment amount; after a candidate is selected, the club pays the appliance partner, which handles removal and installation.

Redmond eligibility and tomorrow’s availability are unconfirmed. Please [contact the club](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107251&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=2CEkfrLiLRKh&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bellevuesunriserotary.org%2Fcontact-us%2F) about your refrigerator.

questions.q: I am shopping for the December 1 grocery bags. The appliance page says tissues and the homepage sentence says liquid hand soap. What should I buy?
questions.theirs: The appliance page says its grocery list has moved to the homepage. For three logo bags, the homepage lists chips: one 7–12 oz bag; bread: one loaf; nut-free candy: 1–3 bars; cereal: one regular box; flour tortillas: 10-pack; corn tortillas: 20–30-pack; toilet paper: two plastic-wrapped rolls; milk: one gallon whole or 2%. Its dated hygiene table says two bars of soap for December 1 and shampoo for December 8. Published volunteer assignments already name Steve D and Steve R for those dates.
questions.ours:
For **December 1**, buy **two bars of soap**. The appliance page’s shopping list is retired, and liquid hand soap was the November 17 item; the homepage’s dated table specifies bars of soap for December 1.

For the three Bellevue Sunrise logo bags, the full list is:

- Chips: 1 bag, 7–12 oz
- Bread: 1 loaf, white or wheat
- Candy: 1–3 chocolate or other candy bars, no nuts
- Cereal: 1 regular-size box
- Flour tortillas: 1 pack of 10
- Corn tortillas: 1 pack of 20–30
- Toilet paper: 2 rolls, wrapped in a plastic bag
- Milk: 1 gallon, whole or 2%
- Hygiene item: 2 bars of soap

[View the grocery list on the club’s homepage](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107269&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=2CEkfrLiLRKh&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bellevuesunriserotary.org%2F)

**Visitor:** What changes for December 8, and can you assign me that shift?

**Subsights:** For December 8, replace the two bars of soap with **shampoo**; the rest of the grocery list stays the same.

I can’t assign the shift. The published roster names Steve R for December 8; please [contact the club](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107271&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=2CEkfrLiLRKh&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bellevuesunriserotary.org%2Fcontact-us%2F) about volunteering or changing the roster.
questions.outcome: Changing the date changes the hygiene item while keeping the rest of the grocery list. Volunteer changes go through the club.
